partition: Seeded allocation of existing company daily starts and exits weighted by available group stock; no transfers or person records.
methodSelection: Fixed before evaluation; no winner chosen from assessment scores.

interval.quantile: order statistic ceil((n+1)*0.9), no interpolation; unavailable if rank exceeds n
interval.yearEndInterval: unavailable; reserved quarter not used for validation
interval.qualificationTiming: Retrospective simulation qualification, never available at either historical forecast origin.

validationUnit: One entire independently seeded history and one held-out assessment-quarter total per family/group; months and calibration folds are not independent samples.
custody: Protocol committed before new group generation/scoring. Generator and scenario families are visible; seed separation is a constructed simulation validation, not blinded or real-world validation.
failurePolicy: Keep unavailable folds/groups and failed gates visible. Do not retune ranges, alter seeds, fill missing periods, infer suppressed counts, or change targets after seeing scores.
